meta.method: in-page destroy.owl.carousel + re-create with page-own options (copied from owl data options), overriding only: VX = rtl:false + responsive center:true for keys<992; VX3 = rtl:false + center:false for keys<992; VB = unchanged; nav/dots true. RTL only, widths 375/576/768, BASE re-measured at-load in same session. walk = prev until hidden, next until hidden, each dot (round-2 crawl); max-walk includes the load state; strict variant excludes it.
meta.conditions: (i) cur@load>=base; (ii) controls present; (iii) every other card max-walk pct>=base at-load pct; (iv) full-visible set over walk (incl load) ⊇ base full set at load
